target.title: fix(ui): focus composer when starting a new chat
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Starting a new Control UI chat required an extra click before typing, and the shell did not expose the expected Cmd/Ctrl+N new-chat shortcut.

## Why This Change Was Made
Checked main plus related open PR #84827 before implementing. That PR covers guarded /, N, Esc, and Cmd/Ctrl+K shortcuts, but not Cmd/Ctrl+N or composer focus after creating a chat.

This PR proposes routing new-chat creation through the existing session creation/navigation flow while carrying a focus request to the active chat pane. The global shortcut is ignored from inputs, textareas, select controls, contenteditable editors, textbox roles, common code editors, and dialogs.

## User Impact
Users can start typing immediately after creating a chat from the sidebar, the chat pane, or Cmd/Ctrl+N/Ctrl+N outside editable controls. Existing session selection, split panes, active-run guards, and mobile behavior are preserved.

## Evidence
- node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/app/app-host.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-page.test.ts ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.test.ts ui/src/lib/sessions/index.test.ts --reporter=verbose
- node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs ui/src/app/app-host.ts ui/src/app/app-host.test.ts ui/src/components/app-sidebar.ts ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.ts ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/route.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-page.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-page.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-pane.ts
- pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 ui/src/app/app-host.ts ui/src/app/app-host.test.ts ui/src/components/app-sidebar.ts ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.ts ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/route.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-page.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-page.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-pane.ts
- pnpm tsgo:test:ui
- git diff --check
- Browser smoke: /chat?session=agent%3Ahistory-002&focusComposer=1 focuses the composer textarea; Meta+N from the focused textarea leaves the route unchanged. The local mock gateway does not implement sessions.create, so the new-session creation path is covered by focused app shell tests.
